subject: Welcome to VedicHour
body:
Welcome to VedicHour. You now have a private, modern Vedic timing dashboard that translates Jyotish into plain English. We rate all 18 planetary hours (horas) each day, using Swiss Ephemeris + Lahiri ayanamsa, so you can notice clearer or heavier windows for reflection and planning. Start by pulling your free Kundli; it gives your dashboard the birth context it needs.

Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.
For reflection and planning only. Not medical, legal, financial, or emergency advice.
linter_reason: Content aligns with timing awareness, reflection, and planning. No block/flag keywords.
